expected: K1 3 says b151 emits beqz+nop where the target uses branch-likely and calls it the main unexplained compiler-boundary gap; it does not say the pinned build emits the likely form when the annulled instruction belongs to the second return
hypothesis: mwcc emits the likely form for the branch whose taken path is the shorter tail; writing the fall-through return first puts the constant return on the taken path. The blanket boundary reading in K1 3 costs attempts on every two-way return
